message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most widely read and celebrated titles written by **J.K. Rowling**: | Series / Author Name | Notable Titles | Year Published | |----------------------|---------------|----------------| | **Harry Potter** (as *Joanne K. Rowling*) | • *Philosopher’s/ Sorcerer’s Stone*
• *Chamber of Secrets*
• *Prisoner of Azkaban*
• *Goblet of Fire*
• *Order of the Phoenix*
• *Half‑Blood Prince*
• *Deathly Hallows* | 1997–2007 | | **Fantastic Beasts & Where to Find Them** (film tie‑in novel) | • *Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them* | 2018 | | **Crossover Novels** (under her own name) | • *The Casual Vacancy* | 2012 | | **Cormoran Strike Mysteries** (pseudonym *Robert Galbraith*) | • *The Cuckoo’s Calling*
• *The Silkworm*
• *Career of Evil*
• *Lethal White*
• *Troubled Blood*
• *The Ink Black Heart* | 2011–present | ### Why These Books Are Popular - **Harry Potter** – A global phenomenon; over 500 million copies sold worldwide, adapted into an award‑winning film franchise, theme parks, merchandise, and more. - **Fantastic Beasts** – Expands the wizarding world beyond Hogwarts, appealing both to long‑time fans and new readers. - **The Casual Vacancy** – Her first adult novel outside the fantasy genre, praised for its social critique and character depth. - **Cormoran Strike** – A gritty detective series that showcases Rowling’s versatility as a writer, blending mystery, humor, and contemporary issues. If you’re looking for something different than the Harry Potter universe but still want Rowling’s storytelling style, give one of the **Cormoran Strike** mysteries or *The Casual Vacancy* a try!
